svg.title: Basic++ — file structure, pipeline, and build order
svg.desc: Horizontal swimlane diagram showing five modules of Basic++ across three layers: foundations, compiler pipeline, and entry point. Wires carry labelled data between stages. A dependency matrix at the bottom shows import relationships.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Lexer tokenize source code?')
sendPrompt('How does the Parser build an AST?')
sendPrompt('How does the Emitter generate bytecode from an AST?')
sendPrompt('How does the BVM execute bytecode?')
sendPrompt('How does the cli.py entry point work?')
